caption:
Instagram changed how reach works.

Instagram confirmed it: three signals now decide who sees your content. Watch time, likes per reach, and sends. Hashtags no longer move the needle.

The platform also widened its repost penalty. It used to hit reels only. Now photos and carousels lose Explore eligibility too, if the content isn't yours. Old followers still see it. New ones never find you.

What to change this week:

1. Post only what you made. No regrams, no recycled graphics.

2. Write for the send. People forward what solves a problem for them.

3. Cap hashtags at five and keep them specific to your trade.

4. Keep reels between 30 and 60 seconds. That's the current reach window.

Staying original every week is hard for a busy shop.

The Black Arrow platform drafts a week of on-brand posts from one goal. You approve. It ships.

rationale: Reels win reach for cold-audience news, and this interprets Instagram's reported 2026 ranking signals and widened repost penalty into concrete weekly actions, bridging to the platform's verified AI content feature for owners who can't stay original and consistent alone.
